title: Dear Kevin Love -  I'm not mad at you, just really disappointed
text:
I purchased this subscription box as a xmas gift for my husband. It arrived this week and I decided to peek inside before I wrapped it. AND DEAR LORD, I'm so glad I did!
Not only are the contents laughably bad -but several of the items "included" are not actually in the box. You get coupons for the blanket and essential oil - which are sent separately from the vendor.
Prepared to be underwhelmed by a random smattering of mini size skin care products, a sample of natural dental floss, two facial sheet masks, a fuggly GQ smiley face pin (WTF?), all natural deodorant w/ a scent reminiscent of rank doom room incense, AND A PENCIL POUCH.
Not a dopp kit.
A pencil pouch.

It's like the contents of a bathroom junk drawer.
Not cool GQ, not cool at all.
label: negative
